class Entry(models.Model):
    """
    Model for blog entries.
    """
    title = models.CharField(_('title'), max_length=200)
    slug = models.SlugField(_('slug'), unique_for_date='publication_date')
    body = models.TextField(_('body'), help_text=_('The main body of the entry.'))
    author = models.ForeignKey(User, verbose_name=_('author'))
    publication_date = models.DateTimeField(_('publication date'), blank=True, null=True)
    sites = models.ManyToManyField(Site, verbose_name=_('sites'), help_text=_('The site(s) this entry should appear on.'),
                                   default=lambda: [settings.SITE_ID])

    objects = EntryManager()

    class Meta:
        verbose_name = _('entry')
        verbose_name_plural = _('entries')
        ordering = ['-publication_date']
